beats.note: What would help you wake up on time?

copy.caption: Tired of being the family alarm clock? Try: “What would help you wake up on time?” They pick the plan, and the wake-up is theirs. Free Parent Script Cards: link in bio.
copy.yt_title: Stop Being the Family Alarm Clock (Parent Script)
copy.pin_title: What to Say Instead of Nagging Kids to Wake Up
copy.pin_desc: A parent script for mornings: ask “What would help you wake up on time?” so your child picks the plan and you stop being the alarm clock. For parents of kids 9-13, from the Julia Redmond executive function series.
